research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 106 or 107 row; complete Army comparison; CIA and current Library of Congress checks; John R Davies exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, military, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Eight exact-name Army rows cannot be distinguished without a private identifier. Five LoC results have different initials or nineteenth-century dates; the RAF and modern obituary namesakes have incompatible service or age.
research_attempts.research_notes: The indexed T/Sgt rank supports enlisted classification only; no identity, occupation, or employer is assigned.
research_attempts.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 169 for full name, birth details, Army unit, occupation, employer, OSS assignment, and chronology.
